prompts.logo: Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished primary logo concept for SysKata, a daily hands-on Linux and automation learning platform for adults. Mascot Kata is a friendly red panda: rust orange fur, cream cheek patches, dark charcoal ears and paws, distinctive striped tail. Clean flat vector-like illustration, restrained geometric forms, strong silhouette, professional but approachable, no gradients or 3D. A compact seated red panda with its tail curled beside it, wearing a small teal utility satchel with a subtle >_ terminal symbol, next to a beautifully spaced dark charcoal rounded sans-serif wordmark reading exactly "SysKata". Horizontal logo lockup, centered with generous margins, truly transparent background. Only text is SysKata. No hats, martial arts costume, extra slogans, mockups or watermark. Make the mascot simple enough to read at small sizes.
prompts.icon: Use case: logo-brand. Using the reference logo as the character identity reference, create a second SysKata logo asset: a compact square mascot icon, no wordmark and no text. Preserve Kata the red panda: rust orange fur, cream cheek patches and eyebrows, charcoal inner ears and paws, cheerful curious expression, teal accessory. Simplify into a head-and-shoulders icon with a hint of teal satchel strap, large friendly face, balanced nearly symmetric composition with generous padding. Clean flat geometric vector-like shapes, minimal detail, crisp silhouette, professional approachable learning-platform identity, readable as a GitHub avatar or app icon. Truly transparent background, no enclosing square, no shadows, no gradients, no 3D, no hat, no watermark. Match the original mascot closely.
